is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles culicifacies s.l.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports only phenotypic insecticide susceptibility and intensity bioassays. It does not genotype any of the specified insecticide-resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data (RR/RS/SS counts or frequencies) are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in India, which is not in Africa.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study reporting new bioassay data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies districts Dindori (Madhya Pradesh), and Kanker and Bastar (Chhattisgarh).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reports collection in 2021 and 2022.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new study reporting original bioassay data.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is included in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study reports on insecticide susceptibility and intensity bioassays for Anopheles culicifacies in three districts in India (Dindori, Kanker, and Bastar). It does not perform any molecular genotyping of resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: african_field_population: Study conducted in India, not Africa.
